Privacy Policy

This page explains what the Monzero Wallet app does with your information.

Data Collected

Your wallet keys, seed, addresses and transaction history are stored only on your device. Keys never leave the device. To find and send transactions the app connects to the Monzero node you choose (node.monzero.org by default); that node can see your IP address and the transactions you broadcast, but not your keys or balance.

The app has no analytics, no advertising and no account. It does not fetch market prices or use any exchange service.

App Permissions

  • INTERNET : Connect to the Monzero network through a Monzero node
  • WAKE_LOCK : Keep the device awake while syncing
  • CAMERA : Scan QR codes for addresses
  • FOREGROUND_SERVICE : Keep the wallet syncing while it is open
  • ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE : Notice when the connection drops
  • READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE : Import wallet backups you choose
  • USE_BIOMETRIC / USE_FINGERPRINT : Optional fingerprint unlock
  • BLUETOOTH : Inherited hardware-wallet support; unused, as no hardware wallet supports Monzero yet

Changes to this Privacy Policy

Changes are published in the app and on monzero.org.

This Privacy Policy was last updated: 24 October 2026.

Contact Us
